title: RWP2 content app
description: Scaffold a fully-wired content app that is compliant with 06 by construction.

name.description: App id everywhere: project name, manifest id, API prefix. Kebab-case.

displayName.description: Manifest name and tab labels. Defaults to title-cased name.

icon.description: PrimeIcons class for the manifest icon.

port.description: Dev serve port. Defaults to the next free 42xx port.

backendPort.description: Proxy target for the team's local Java service. Defaults to port + 4000.

standaloneRepo.description: Emit to dist/team-templates instead of apps/, for teams outside the monorepo.
